title: Herbal Flaky Malaysian Cheese Samosas
description: A fragrant, keto‑friendly Malaysian samosa with a creamy fromage frais filling, tossed in aromatic herbs and baked to a crisp, flaky finish in a tandoor‑style oven.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 °F (200 °C); if you have a tandoor or pizza stone, place it inside.
In a bowl combine almond flour, coconut flour, salt, pepper, ground cumin, and ground coriander; add melted butter and stir until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Knead the dough with a few tablespoons of water until smooth, then cover and let rest for 10 minutes.
In another bowl mix fromage frais, shredded cheddar, chopped cilantro, mint, and beaten egg yolk; season lightly with salt and pepper.
Divide the dough into 12 equal portions, roll each into a thin oval, then fold into a triangle shape and seal the edges with a little water.
Place the prepared samosas on a parchment‑lined baking sheet, brush the tops with melted butter.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until golden and flaky; if using a tandoor, bake 18 minutes at the same temperature.
Let the samosas cool for 5 minutes before serving.
